about: Test files that take over about 5 seconds. `npm run test:slow` runs them; `npm test`, `npm run check` and the per-part test:* scripts run every other file. Nothing here is skipped for good: each file keeps its measured time so it can move back once it is faster. Seconds on a busy machine at the load given: alone is the file run by itself, full_run its duration inside `npx vitest run`. Files that guard safety stay in the fast group unless they take over about 30 seconds; kept_fast lists those over 5.

files.covers: the agent runner gives Haiku five tries on the discovery asks and other models three: eight tries, each with its before/after check

the one-click demo in real tmux on fake machines: layout, each ending's teardown (pass, missed, q, Ctrl-C, SIGTERM, SIGHUP, a killed client, a crash), the attached window, the real scene file on both backends

kept_fast.why: safety: the sandbox, teardown on every ending, the leak canaries and never deleting a folder a command names
